visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-opening key visual with the page headline set as coloured ribbon bands
visualCharacteristics.layout: 16:9 image offset two columns and bleeding right, ribbon headline over it (>= 720) or overlapping its foot (< 720)
notable:
Each
in the heading starts a new ribbon band
Ribbon colour primary, secondary or gradient (default gradient)
Image loaded eagerly with high fetch priority
Cells decoded by query, not by position

contentPattern.structure: one cell with the key visual picture and the page h1 heading (line breaks split ribbon bands)
contentPattern.rows: 1 row, picture and heading in any cell

usage: Use once at the top of a page to show the key visual and the page title.
reuseGuidance: Fits a single image plus a short one- to three-line headline; not for body copy, CTAs or multiple slides.
